content: {"phoneNote":"The fixed header plus call bar sits mid-page in the whole-page capture and overlaps the 'Naša zgodba' section, while the hero stacks a header 'Pokličite' button with another 'Pokličite nas' link directly below.","desktopNote":"The sticky header bar is drawn over the hero headline in the full-page capture and the hero's left half is a dead empty column with no photo or element to balance the text.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Fill the empty left half of the desktop hero (and the gap below the phone hero) with a photo of the office/team or a strong typographic device so the first screen is not half blank.","Remove the duplicate call actions: keep the header 'Pokličite' and drop the 'Pokličite nas' text link in the hero; merge 'Kje nas najdete' and 'Obiščite nas' into one address block.","Give the '2004' numeral a fixed relationship to its label on desktop (it currently collides with 'Delamo od leta') and tighten the oversized bottom padding of the services and pricing sections."],"blockers":["Desktop, whole page: the sticky header bar is rendered on top of the hero headline, covering 'podjetja in društva v Pomurju'.","Phone, whole page: the sticky header and call bar overlap the 'Naša zgodba' section text.","Desktop, 'Delamo od leta' section: the giant '2004' overlaps the 'Delamo od leta' label and the section heading above is clipped.","Both viewports: address and 'Navodila za pot' are repeated in 'Kje nas najdete' and again in 'Obiščite nas' directly below."]}
